o1: Predicted to enable Wnt-protein binding activity. Involved in Wnt signaling pathway; embryonic morphogenesis; left/right axis specification; and vulval cell fate specification. Is part of the Wnt signaling pathway. Is located in basolateral plasma membrane and cytoplasmic vesicle. Is expressed in CAN; anal region; hypodermis; intestinal muscle; and ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Zaki syndrome. Orthologous to human WLS (Wnt ligand secretion mediator).
